name: math-skill-edges
description: Skills edge cases from review round 2 (2aa2dc0) and the re-review (abdc648). N7a: mastery a killed round already saved is celebrated on relaunch, one level-up per skill (#13 queue). #13: quitting a round banks and celebrates what it mastered. N6: a double tap on Done steps back once. N9: Go again after Practice misses returns to the skill Race. #5: importing a sibling's export names them and offers Undo. N1: starting a round closes a pending Undo. #6/N5: a write refused half way rolls back and says so.

steps.label: fixture: two skills fully solid but never celebrated (a round saved, then the app was killed); Addition to 10 one fact short
relaunch celebrates what the killed round mastered, first of two (re-review N7a, review #13 queue)
the second skill gets its own moment
answer until 4 + 5 comes up and is answered, then pause
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var n=0,hit=false;while(!hit&&!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<10){hit=/^(4 \+ 5|5 \+ 4)$/.test(document.getElementById('problem').textContent);type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}document.getElementById('pauseBtn').click();await sleep(100);return hit&&!document.getElementById('pauseOv').hidden;})()

steps.label: quitting still banks and celebrates the skill it mastered (review #13)
a double tap on Done steps back once and stays in the app (re-review N6)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var b=document.getElementById('lvlDone');b.click();b.click();await sleep(600);return /\/math\/$/.test(location.pathname)&&document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden&&history.state&&history.state.mathDepth===0;})()

steps.label: the Skills home counts the skill the quit round mastered
a skill race with one miss, then Practice misses
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}var a=ans();type(a===9?8:a+1);await sleep(450);var n=0;while(!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<30){type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}await sleep(200);if(document.getElementById('drillBtn').hidden)return false;document.getElementById('drillBtn').click();await sleep(300);n=0;while(!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<10){type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}return !document.getElementById('resLayer').hidden;})()

steps.label: Go again after the drill is the skill RACE the kid came from, not a practice (re-review N9)
import a sibling's export: it names whose skills they were and offers Undo (review #5)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}window.__before=localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1');var doc=MathSkills.exportProfile('Mia',{},{'x-11-12':{stars:3,masteredAt:5}},Date.now());var dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(new File([JSON.stringify(doc)],'mia.json',{type:'application/json'}));var inp=document.getElementById('importFile');inp.files=dt.files;inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));await sleep(400);var t=Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.toast'),function(x){return x.textContent;}).join('|');var e=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1'));return /Mia/.test(t)&&/Undo/.test(t)&&e['x-11-12']&&e['x-11-12'].stars===3;})()

steps.label: Undo puts the player's own skills back
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}document.querySelector('.toast .toastGo').click();await sleep(200);return localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1')===window.__before;})()

steps.label: starting a round closes a pending Undo, so it can neither sit on the keypad nor be undone by the round's end (re-review N1)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}await sleep(5500);var doc=MathSkills.exportProfile('Mia',{},{'x-11-12':{stars:3,masteredAt:5}},Date.now());var dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(new File([JSON.stringify(doc)],'mia.json'));var inp=document.getElementById('importFile');inp.files=dt.files;inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));await sleep(400);var live=document.querySelector('.toast .toastGo');if(!live||live.disabled)return false;document.querySelector('#nextCard [data-go="race"]').click();await sleep(450);var still=Array.prototype.some.call(document.querySelectorAll('.toast .toastGo'),function(b){return !b.disabled&&b.closest('.toast').classList.contains('on');});document.getElementById('pauseBtn').click();await sleep(100);document.getElementById('quitBtn').click();await sleep(400);return !still;})()

steps.label: a write refused half way rolls back and says so (review #6, re-review N5: only the skills key throws)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function lvl(){return document.getElementById('lvlLayer').hidden?null:document.getElementById('lvlName').textContent;}await sleep(5500);var orig=Storage.prototype.setItem;var factsBefore=localStorage.getItem('math.facts.pAva.v1'),skillsBefore=localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1');Storage.prototype.setItem=function(k,v){if(/^math\.skills\./.test(k))throw new Error('QuotaExceededError');return orig.call(this,k,v);};var doc=MathSkills.exportProfile('Ava',{'x:7:8':{n:3,miss:0,box:1,ms:900,last:5,ok:1}},{'x-6-7':{stars:3,masteredAt:5}},Date.now());var dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(new File([JSON.stringify(doc)],'a.json'));var inp=document.getElementById('importFile');inp.files=dt.files;inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));await sleep(400);Storage.prototype.setItem=orig;var t=Array.prototype.map.call(document.querySelectorAll('.toast'),function(x){return x.textContent;}).join('|');return /Could not save/.test(t)&&!/imported into/i.test(t)&&localStorage.getItem('math.facts.pAva.v1')===factsBefore&&localStorage.getItem('math.skills.pAva.v1')===skillsBefore;})()
